title: Knowledge and technology outputs: India's points above the median economy, weighted

metadata.comparability: WIPO: scores and rankings are not directly comparable between one year and another (GII 2026, Appendix I).
metadata.definition: Weight x (India's pillar score - median pillar score across 139 economies). Weights follow the GII formula: 1/10 for each input pillar, 1/4 for each output pillar. The parts sum to India's score minus a typical economy's pillar-weighted score.
